core-pod.selectstated.podfiles.says: Reading the pod files a question about stated facts needs.

core-pod.filled.podfiles.says: Reading the pod files that fill in a half-built answer.

core-pod.step.readback.says: Reading the pod's saved answers back in before a step, so the step can carry on from them.

core-pod.step.database.says: Updating the saved database after a step.

core-pod.builtdigests.says: Checking that each saved answer file is still the one the saved state was made with.

core-pod.besidedigest.says: Fingerprinting the saved state kept beside the pod, to check it is intact when the pod opens.

arrivals.records.podfiles.says: Reading the pod files that hold the records an import compares with.

arrivals.current.podfiles.says: Reading the pod files of the current versions of records.

kept.reached.recordsofjudged.says: Finding the records those judgments are about.

kept.readback.says: Reading the saved answers back in when the pod opens.

kept.readback.restore.says: Restoring the saved answers into memory.

kept.readback.index.says: Rebuilding the lookup list of the saved answers.

kept.reached.written.says: Finding the records whose files the step wrote.

matcher.view.podfiles.says: Reading the pod files the matcher compares.

pod-database.keyed.screens.says: Updating the saved database's ready-made answer tables.

pod-database.keyed.ledger.says: Recording what the saved database now holds.
